headline: Revenue, profit, and cash surge across the board
summary_short: Revenue rose 50% year-over-year to $3.27 billion (+14% quarter-over-quarter); diluted EPS of $12.53 climbed 92% y/y as net income of $441.6 million rose 91% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue reached $3.27 billion, up 50% year-over-year and 14% quarter-over-quarter. Gross profit was $844 million (+66% y/y); operating income $557 million (+86% y/y); EBITDA $611 million (+84% y/y). Net income of $441.6 million (+91% y/y) drove diluted EPS to $12.53 (+92% y/y). Cash climbed to $1.85 billion, up 459% y/y and 77% q/q, while shareholders' equity rose to $3.22 billion (+63% y/y).
